Resource Profile: BIH Senologie Bildgebung Observation

Official URL: https://www.senologie.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/senologie-bildgebung-observation Version: 0.10.0
Draft as of 2026-10-12 Computable Name: Senologie_Bildgebung_Observation

Observation für einzelne Bildgebungs-Befunde (BI-RADS, ACR, Herdbefund, Mikrokalk, LK-Status)

Usages:

  • Examples for this Profile: Observation/Example-Bildgebung-BiRADS-Links, Observation/Example-Bildgebung-BiRADS-Rechts, Observation/Fall1-BiRADS-Links, Observation/Fall10-BiRADS-Rechts... , Observation/Fall11-BiRADS-Links, Observation/Fall12-BiRADS-Links, Observation/Fall2-BiRADS-Rechts, Observation/Fall3-BiRADS-Rechts, Observation/Fall4-BiRADS-Links, Observation/Fall5-BiRADS-Rechts, Observation/Fall6-BiRADS-Links, Observation/Fall7-BiRADS-Rechts, Observation/Fall8-BiRADS-Rechts and Observation/Fall9-BiRADS-Links
